description: Pro. Build a scored, exportable markdown report from heuristic evaluation findings you have written. Each finding has heuristic (1 to 10), severity (0 to 4), location, issue, effect, fix and optional effort (S, M, L) and evaluator. Merges duplicates across evaluators, computes a health score, and sorts a fix-first table.
name: build_heuristic_report
title: Heuristic report
